description: This file contains a Python test class for integrating and running Xen Test Framework (XTF) test cases within the OpenEmbedded QA environment. It defines methods for querying, filtering, and executing XTF test cases, and includes decorators for dependencies and timeouts.

classes.name: XTFMinimalTest
classes.description: A test class that integrates Xen Test Framework (XTF) into OpenEmbedded QA, providing methods to query, filter, and run XTF test cases.

methods.name: query_xtf_cases
methods.description: Queries the xtf-runner for a list of test cases based on a query item.

methods.name: get_xtf_case_list
methods.description: Retrieves and filters the list of XTF test cases based on environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: run_xtf_case
methods.description: Executes a specific XTF test case and asserts success.
